title: Neural Wasserstein Splines: Representation-Invariant Second-Order Priors for Trajectory Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.19878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Population dynamics are often observed only as unpaired snapshots, which leave the evolution between measurements underdetermined. Second-order regularization can constrain it, but a penalty on the accelerations of sampled particles is a prior on joint particle paths, and different particle representations of the same marginal curve can have different acceleration costs. We therefore introduce Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP), a sample-based method that learns a continuous population curve under a Wasserstein smoothness prior. A neural network maps latent variables to the control points of a cubic spline in time, so samples at any time come from the spline basis without numerical integration. We project the generator's velocity onto gradients of a finite dictionary of scalar potentials and differentiate this measure-dependent projection in time, obtaining a finite-dimensional surrogate for the intrinsic Wasserstein acceleration, trained

translated_title: 神经瓦瑟斯坦样条：用于轨迹推断的表示不变二阶先验
translated_abstract: 种群动态通常只能以不成对的快照形式被观测到，这使得测量之间的演化过程欠定。二阶正则化可以约束这一演化，但对采样粒子加速度施加惩罚是对联合粒子路径的先验，而同一边际曲线的不同粒子表示可能具有不同的加速度代价。为此，我们提出了神经瓦瑟斯坦样条（Neural Wasserstein Splines, NWSP），这是一种基于样本的方法，在瓦瑟斯坦平滑先验下学习连续的种群曲线。一个神经网络将潜变量映射为时间上三次样条的控制点，因此任意时刻的样本都可以直接由样条基产生，而无需数值积分。我们将生成器的速度投影到有限标量势字典的梯度上，并对这一依赖于测度的投影进行时间求导，从而得到内在瓦瑟斯坦加速度的有限维替代量，用于训练……
tldr: 提出神经瓦瑟斯坦样条（NWSP），通过瓦瑟斯坦平滑先验和内在瓦瑟斯坦加速度的有限维替代量，实现表示不变的二阶正则化，从而从不成对的快照中学习连续的种群演化曲线。
en_tdlr: Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP) learns continuous population curves from unpaired snapshots through a representation-invariant second-order Wasserstein smoothness prior, combining a neural spline generator with a finite-dimensional surrogate of the intrinsic Wasserstein acceleration.
